source.asset_caveat: Rehosted via EgoIT-99K; not byte-verified against the original HoloAssist archive. Follow the source dataset terms.

review_scope.sampling: Existing contact sheets at approximately 1 FPS; not frame-exhaustive.
review_scope.interval_precision: Approximate; event boundaries are sample-bracketed where possible.

episode_summary: A person interacts with a large office printer. They manipulate its controls and display, handle sheets or instruction material on top of the printer, then move to the lower paper drawers and open a drawer. The sampled visuals do not establish the precise paper or cartridge operation at the end.

events.action: The person presses printer controls; the central display changes from dark to visibly illuminated by approximately 16.5 seconds.
The person reaches toward the printer controls; the central display is illuminated at approximately 41.5 seconds and appears dark by approximately 43.5 seconds.
events.confidence: high_for_sampled_display_states; exact state-change time is approximate

events.action: The person lifts, turns, and examines sheets on or beside the printer.
events.unresolved: The sampled frames do not establish the sheet contents, whether paper is loaded into the printer, or the specific purpose of the sheet handling.

events.action: The person moves to the lower printer drawers and opens/manipulates a drawer.
events.unresolved: The final sampled views are blurred or partial; do not label a cartridge replacement, successful paper loading, or drawer contents without closer review.

protected_facts: Display illumination changes during this one chronological recording; these observed state changes are not replay evidence about a past event.
Do not infer successful paper loading or cartridge replacement from the coarse final samples.
The display state at the end of the sampled interval is separate from its earlier state.

quality_control.note: Pilot-only draft based on sampled contact sheets. A second reviewer should inspect the full video and verify action boundaries. This source has prior model experiments and must not be held out as a test item.
